Costco's fiscal 2026 ends around August 30, 2026, which is after my knowledge cutoff, so I don't have the reported number. My best estimate is **about $2.1 billion**, but it is not a reported value and could be well off.

The estimate rests on three things:
- **No separate Q4 filing:** Costco does not file a 10-Q for Q4. The Q4 figure is the full-year capex in the 10-K minus the nine-month year-to-date capex.
- **Prior-year pattern:** in fiscal 2025, as I recall, full-year capex was roughly $5.3–5.5 billion. Q4 was about $1.8–1.9 billion of that. Costco's Q4 runs 16 weeks, so it carries a larger share of annual spending than the other quarters.
- **Fiscal 2026 outlook:** I believe management pointed to higher spending in fiscal 2026, around $6–6.5 billion, as warehouse openings accelerate. Applying the same seasonal share to that total gives about $2.1 billion for Q4.
